{{Infobox Animal |image= {{Media |Model BotW= [[File:BotW Patricia Model.png|320x320px]] |Model TotK= [[File:TotK Patricia Model.png|320x320px]] }} |caption= |title= {{Infobox Game Blocks |AoC= The Best Sand Seal }} |species= [[Sand Seal]] |gender= Female |game= BotW, TotK |other= AoC |era= [[Era of the Wilds]] |family= {{List| * [[Riju]] {{Small|(owner)}} * Riju's mother {{Small|(former owner)}} }} |voiceactor= |theme= |nocat= }} '''Patricia''' is a recurring [[Sand Seal]] in {{TLoZ Series}}. {{Terminology |- | {{Term/Store|Patricia||Series, BotW, TotK, AoC}} | {{List| * {{BotW}} * {{TotK}} * {{AoC}} }} }} ==Characteristics== ==={{BotW|-}}=== {{Compendium/Extract|Patricia}} Patricia is a [[Sand Seal]] belonging to [[Riju]], the chief of the [[Gerudo]]. She was given to Riju as a gift from her mother. Riju is known to dote on Patricia, such as adorning her with a ribbon. Patricia resides in the [[Palace Courtyard]], which is located in the southwestern corner of [[Gerudo Town]]. [[Padda]], who acts as Patricia's guard, can also be found in the Courtyard. Patricia is noted to be more agile and outgoing than the average Sand Seal, and she is always ready to take Riju [[Sand-Seal Surfing|Surfing]]. Much of the [[Fruit]] that Patricia eats is supplied by [[Lorn]] from her [[Lorn's Fruit Stand|Fruit Stand]]. Patricia has the power to deliver divine messages, which has resulted in her being referred to as an oracle. If offered [[Fruit]], Patricia will share her wisdom, though she can only be understood by certain individuals. Patricia likes [[Wildberry|Wildberries]] in particular, and she will share special messages if provided with them. Padda is capable of translating Patricia's messages, which often contain Sand Seal puns. When [[Link]] gives regular Fruit to Patricia, her prophecies will involve asking for higher quality Fruit, knocking out Sand Seals with explosions, [[Sand Boots]] and [[Snow Boots]], and warnings about [[Heat]]. When offered Wildberries, Patricia reveals information about [[Molduga]], [[Farosh]], the [[Statue of the Eighth Heroine]], and [[Tera's Great Fairy Fountain]] in the [[Gerudo Desert]]. When [[Divine Beast Vah Naboris]] became active, Riju took Patricia to investigate, though she decided to turn back when she encountered its [[Lightning]] and [[Sandstorm]]. However, Patricia was scared by a [[Monster]] on their way back, and she ended up fleeing directly towards Vah Naboris. As a result of this, Riju lost consciousness, but she was later rescued by [[Buliara]]. During the "[[Divine Beast Vah Naboris (Quest)|Divine Beast Vah Naboris]]" [[Main Quest]], Riju asks Link to meet her and Patricia at the [[Lookout Post]]. In order to approach Divine Beast Vah Naboris with Link, Riju Surfs with Patricia through the [[East Barrens]]. After Vah Naboris has been calmed, word of Patricia and Riju's part in doing so spreads throughout Gerudo Town. Riju will also begin to visit Patricia in the mornings in order to speak with her. ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{Compendium/Extract/TotK|Patricia}} {{Stub|TotK}} As in her {{BotW}} incarnation, Patricia has the power to deliver divine messages, which has resulted in her being referred to as an oracle. If offered [[Fruit]], Patricia will share her wisdom. When fed [[Splash Fruit]]s, Patricia provides strings of coordinates. Padda is capable of translating Patricia's messages, which often contain Sand Seal puns. When [[Link]] gives regular Fruit to Patricia, her prophecies will involve [[Sand Boots]] and [[Snow Boots]], the [[Desert Voe Set]], how to resist [[Freezing Climate]]s, the location of the [[Statue of the Eighth Heroine]], [[Sinkhole]]s, the movement of [[Dragon]]s, and requesting Splash Fruits. During the [[Scenario]] "[[Air and Lightning]]", [[Terrako]] summons Riju and Patricia to [[Divine Beast Vah Naboris]] to save [[Urbosa]] from [[Thunderblight Ganon]]. After [[Calamity Ganon]] is defeated at the end of "[[The Future of Hyrule]]", the two of them will be returned to their original time. {{Noncanon|End}} ==Trivia== * Patricia, the [[Giant Horse]], the [[White Horse]], and the [[Lord of the Mountain]] are the only individuals to get their own unique entries in the [[Hyrule Compendium]] separate from the rest of their species. * In the Canadian French, European French, and Japanese versions of {{BotW|-}} and {{TotK|-}}, Patricia's entries in the Hyrule Compendium cite her name with the honorifics "madame" and "{{Wp|Japanese honorifics|{{Romanize|ちゃん|-chan}}}}" respectively. * In the Japanese versions of {{BotW|-}} and {{TotK|-}}, Padda refers to Patricia with double honorifics "{{Romanize|ちゃん様|-chan-sama}}", ==Nomenclature== Patricia is the feminine form of the name "Patricius." {{Nomenclature}} ==Gallery== {{All Images}} File:BotW Patricia Concept Art.png|{{Game Label|{{BotW|-}}}}Concept artwork of Riju and Patricia File:AoC Riju Artwork.png|{{Game Label|{{AoC|-}}}}Artwork of Patricia with Riju File:AoC Patricia Introduction.png|{{Game Label|{{AoC|-}}}}Patricia's introduction ==See Also== {{See Also| * Animal * Creature * Riju * Sand Seal }} {{Ref| {{Cite|Patricia does have a particular fondness for {{Color BotW|Blue|wildberries}}, but she'll happily accept any kind of fruit.|Padda|BotW}} {{Cite|Patricia was a present from the former...from my mother.
